credentials.behavior: Two identical groups; exact half-track translation; pause on hover, manual toggle, offscreen or hidden document; static reduced-motion list

components.css: .ds-project{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.4fr);gap:57.6px;padding:36px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);background:transparent;color:var(--text);font:300 15.3px/1.8 var(--font-sans)}.ds-project-heading h3{margin:0;font:400 28.8px/1.18 var(--font-display);letter-spacing:0;text-wrap:balance;overflow-wrap:break-word}.ds-project-category{font-size:12.6px;color:var(--accent);margin:12.6px 0 0}.ds-project-content dl{margin:21.6px 0 0}.ds-project-content dl>div+div{margin-top:18px}.ds-project-content dt{font-size:12.6px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:5.4px}.ds-project-content dd{margin:0;font-size:14.4px;color:var(--text-muted)}.ds-project-content ul{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5.4px 14.4px;list-style:none;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding:16.2px 0 0;margin:21.6px 0 0;font-size:12.6px;color:var(--text-muted)}@media(max-width:690px){.ds-project{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:21.6px;padding:28.8px 0}.ds-project-heading h3{font-size:25.2px}}.ds-project-content li{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent);padding:1.8px 7.2px}

components.css: .ds-mobile-index{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));padding:0 7.2px env(safe-area-inset-bottom);background:var(--page);border-top:1px solid var(--control-border)}.ds-mobile-index button{min-height:50.4px;padding:7.2px 0;border:0;border-top:2px solid transparent;background:transparent;font:300 10.8px/1.8 var(--font-sans);color:var(--text-muted);cursor:pointer}.ds-mobile-index .ds-current{color:var(--text);border-top-color:var(--text);font-weight:600}.ds-mobile-index button:hover{color:var(--text)}.ds-mobile-index button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:5px}

narrative.overview: Cream and charcoal editorial portfolio with purple-only emphasis, stronger type, integrated navigation, contextual icons, and varied repeatable motion.
keyCharacteristics: Original-color badges using native PNG transparency; white artwork preserved
User-supplied light/dark hero scenery with blurred fade
Full-viewport replay lifecycle with separate heading covers
Transparent rail labels and hidden native scrollbar
Previous 90% view approximated at normal zoom
Clearer light scenery with synchronized wash strength
UI/UX Design credential and updated hero summary
Hero artwork credited to furi / ふーり on Pixiv
